jobs.description:
Lead the design, development, and optimization of enterprise applications across back-end and front-end technologies. Architect scalable solutions, apply advanced software design patterns, and mentor junior and medior developers. Utilize the Microsoft ecosystem, modern front-end frameworks, Azure cloud services, messaging platforms, and architectural practices like CQRS, DDD, and Clean Architecture to deliver robust and business-aligned solutions.
Key responsibilities

• Architect and design scalable enterprise applications

• Implement and enforce advanced software patterns (CQRS, DDD, Clean Architecture)

• Design, implement, and maintain MicroServices-based architectures

• Develop clean, secure, and maintainable code across front-end and back-end

• Mentor and coach junior and medior developers, perform code reviews

• Build interactive user interfaces with modern front-end frameworks (Angular, Blazor, React)

• Collaborate with product owners and business analysts to translate requirements into technical solutions

• Implement and optimize containerized solutions with Kubernetes, Docker, or AKS

• Design and integrate distributed systems using messaging Middleware (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, Kafka)

• Leverage Azure services for cloud-native, scalable, and secure solutions

• Ensure CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevOps best practices

Very good knowledge in the following technologies is a plus

• C#

• .NET Core

• ASP.NET Core

• Entity Framework Core

• LINQ

• RESTful API design and integration

• SQL Server

• MicroServices architecture

• CQRS

• DDD

• Clean Architecture principles

• Blazor or Angular

• TypeScript

• JavaScript

• Unit & integration testing

• CI/CD pipelines

• Microsoft Azure

• Kubernetes

• Docker

• AKS

• WPF (XAML) is a plus

• Problem-solving

• Rigorous methodology

Qualifications

• 5+ years in .NET / .NET Core development

• Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field is a plus

• English + French and / or Dutch

Our client is the Belgian market leader in its sector, with a strong ambition to accelerate its international expansion.

While recognized as a leading player in its industry, the company has maintained the agility, entrepreneurial spirit, and close-knit culture of an SME. With a team of approximately 20 professionals, success relies on individuals who combine ownership, initiative, and a willingness to contribute beyond the boundaries of a traditional job description.

To support its continued growth and strengthen its internal organization, the company is looking for a Secretary General/Chief of Staff with a solid legal background and a strong operational mindset.

Jobomschrijving

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Secretary General acts as a trusted partner to the management team, ensuring that the company operates efficiently, compliantly, and in a structured manner.

The role is ideally suited for someone with a background as a lawyer, in-house counsel, or legal professional, who enjoys combining legal rigor with operational involvement. You will be expected to move seamlessly between strategic, cross-functional topics and day-to-day execution.

One hour you may be reviewing an important contractual matter, overseeing compliance obligations, or advising management on governance issues; the next, you may be coordinating an internal project, improving a process, organizing follow-up on key decisions, or liaising with external partners.

We are looking for an individual who combines a helicopter view with a hands-on mentality, who is equally comfortable thinking strategically and executing pragmatically.

Key Responsibilities

Governance, Legal & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, internal policies, and corporate obligations.
• Support management in assessing legal and operational risks.
• Maintain a pragmatic and business-oriented approach to legal matters.

Operational Coordination & Business Support

• Organize internal meetings, monitor action plans, and drive accountability.
• Assist the CEO and management team with strategic and operational priorities.
• Facilitate communication and collaboration across teams and external stakeholders.

Process Improvement & Organizational Excellence

• Bring structure, clarity, and consistency to internal operations.
• Review and improve processes, workflows, and internal controls.
• Ensure that priorities are translated into tangible actions and results.

HR, Administration & Corporate Support

• Support HR administration, onboarding processes, and internal policies.
• Handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
• Contribute to a positive, efficient, and well-organized working environment.

Finance & Corporate Administration

• Oversee administrative aspects of invoicing, reporting, and operational follow-up.
• Coordinate with external accountants and financial advisors.
• Ensure that recurring administrative and financial processes are properly managed and monitored.

External Stakeholder Management

• Coordinate relationships with external accountants, IT providers, insurers, and other professional partners.
• Ensure that external support functions are properly managed and aligned with business needs.

Profile

We are looking for someone who:

• Holds a Master's degree in Law.
• Has approximately 5 years of professional experience, ideally as a lawyer, in-house counsel, legal advisor, or in a similar role combining legal and business responsibilities.
• Possesses a strong legal foundation and an interest in governance, compliance, and corporate organization.
• Combines analytical rigor with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset.
• Enjoys alternating between strategic thinking and operational execution.
• Is highly organized, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality work.
• Is proactive and comfortable taking ownership without requiring constant supervision.
• Thrives in an SME environment where flexibility, initiative, and entrepreneurial spirit are essential.
• Understands that in a team of 20 people, everyone contributes beyond their title and is willing to step outside their comfort zone when needed.
• Is fluent in Dutch, and English. French is a plus.

jobs.occupation: iDSB - International German School Brussels - Head of IT Coordination & Administration
jobs.description:
The purpose of this position is to ensure the daily operation, proper maintenance and development of information and communication systems in order to support a high-quality edcuation and an efficient administration of the school. This role becomes more important over time. A high quality IT infrastructure and very good user experience are distinction criteria for the school and therefore a leverage to reach our strategic long term objectives.

The position holder on the one hand needs to be capable of supporting the school staff with a clientoriented mindset on all IT related issues. On the other hand she/he needs to proactively advise on improvements of the IT Infrastructure, support the decision making process and implement such new solutions.
Your tasks (list is not exhaustive)

• Responsible for the daily operation of the School's Information- and Communication Infrastructure

• Maintenance of all Hard- and Software components used in the school (Server, Antivirus, Backups, wired and wireless networks, Firewalls, video conference equipment, endpoints, telephony).

• Ensure the security of all IT systems (apply security patches, manage configurations, ensure Anti-virus and other security updates)

• Ensure all required IT services are available during school hours (7:30 - 17:30) and on request also outside school hours through pro-active maintenance and SWIFT and effective troubleshooting

• Manage the school provided Mobile devices (laptops, tablets, smartphones, mobile phones)

• Management of Contracts: Software Licenses, Maintenance agreements, IT related leasing

• Installation of new systems (including testing, appropriate communication, training etc.)

• Assure connection to external specialists and leverage them as appropriate for the school

• User access Management (including setting up accounts for new users etc.)

• Creation and maintenance of complete documentation of all ICT systems (e.g. network structure, security architecture, overview of servers in operation, network components, end devices such as PCs, tablets, projectors, smartboards, monitors, ...)

• Proactively advise on system changes or new products, which could improve the IT landscape of the school, both in the area of software as well as Hardware

• Monitor and actively advise on developments in the educational environment (Germany, Belgium) as far as Technology in schools is concerned

• Act as an advisor on general IT topics for the school's headmaster and the administrative board

Organization / exposure

• The jobholder reports to the Head of Administration of the School.

• The position is complemented by a junior IT expert, who would report to the jobholder.

• Day-to-day contact with Teachers, administrative staff and students. Occasional contact with external stakeholders (Parents, Administration Board).

• Motivated IT allrounder with 3-5 years relevant experience

• Expertise in providing 1st Level support for a small to medium organization

• Expertise in Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Windows 10 and network technology

• Experience with selection and implementation of new hard- or software.

• Able to communicate with partners with limited IT background when proposing new solutions or changes to existing solutions

• Ideally some project management experience

• Proactivity - you find issues before they find you, eager to push things forward

• Problem Solving Skills

• Hands-on activities are your thing

• Client oriented mindset; self-organized but also a teamplayer

• Ability to prioritise; Adherence to deadlines

• Languages: solid knowledge of English; basic German; French and / or Dutch desirable but not mandatory
